dsh.step_limit_semantics: External headless step_start supervisor; a boundary request may already be in flight.

runtime_provenance.scope: Historical configured systems only; templates are provenance, not instructions for a new experiment.

snapshot_policy: Current source files observed at export; per-file hashes/mtimes, not asserted pre-run frozen.
source_path_policy: logical source paths only, relative to historical evaluation root
